law.law: Decree-Law No. 4 of 2002 on the flag of the Kingdom of Bahrain

meta.name: Bahrain
note: The proportion, division and triangles are Article 1 of the decree-law, which also refers to an attached model that wasn't in the text read.

The law says only a deep red. The Pantone, CMYK and hex are the specification in the Arabic flag guide on the government's education portal, page 25, which isn't a law. Its RGB is misprinted as 21,0 4,1 28. The Album des Pavillons 2023, as reported by FOTW, agrees on the Pantone and RGB 218-41-28.

restriction.restriction: Article 8: the flag may not be used for commercial purposes, in particular in patents, trademarks or advertising. Article 9 sets the penalties.
